root_cause.text: Missing NULL check for `peer_priv->ipsec` in `mlx5e_ipsec_disable_events`, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the device does not support IPsec and the IPsec structure was never allocated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (peer_priv && peer_priv->ipsec)` before calling `complete_all(&peer_priv->ipsec->comp)`; the CVE description states that the crash occurs because IPsec resources are cleaned up even when the device doesn't support IPsec. The call trace shows the dereference at `complete_all` from `mlx5e_ipsec_disable_events`.

intent_record.what: Changed the condition from `if (peer_priv)` to `if (peer_priv && peer_priv->ipsec)`.
intent_record.how: This prevents a NULL pointer dereference by ensuring `peer_priv->ipsec` is not NULL before calling `complete_all(&peer_priv->ipsec->comp)`.
